notes.title: Netherspace becomes free-to-play!
notes.notes: It is Christmas time and in preparation for the release for the enhanced version of Netherspace and the future release of Netherspace III, I decided to release the first game as a free product for all to enjoy during these holidays. I want to say a big thank you to everyone that supported me by buying my first game but I believe that after the end of every game's commercial cycle it should eventually become a free-to-play product for all to enjoy. Merry Christmas to everyone!
